about: Constraint cards for the idea factory. A hand is one card from each suit. The cards are fragments, never finished ideas: the pitcher has to make them collide. Add cards freely; retire a card once it has made the same kind of idea twice.

place: a place that moves
something enormous, asleep
a home built inside something that used to be alive
a border between two worlds
a workplace on its busiest day
a ruin someone has moved into
a vehicle that is also a village
a place you can reach only once a year
the inside of an instrument
a place that is slowly being swallowed
a crossroads where everyone stops
somewhere very small, shown very large
the underside of something
a place halfway up something tall
a waystation at the edge of the map
a garden that is not on the ground
a market that only opens at one hour
a place built entirely by one stubborn inhabitant
an archive of something that can't be kept
a harbour for things that aren't boats
time: fog that hasn't lifted in days
the last warm evening of the year
the moment just before it rains
the night everyone is waiting for something
the long blue minute after sunset
inhabitants: one inhabitant who is very, very old
a creature everyone else is a little afraid of
a choir or band that never stops
the very smallest inhabitants of somewhere
a newcomer who doesn't fit yet
light: a single lamp in a large dark
overcast and shadowless, colour carries it
two light sources of different colours
composition: one huge thing and many tiny things
a spiral the eye follows inward
a stage with wings and a backdrop
foreground so close it's out of scale
mechanic: a chain reaction you can start
the scene notices where you've been
the mood shifts with where you point
a tide that rises and falls
a secret that opens if you linger
